newsitem.title: USA: Grace Q3 EPS from discontinued opns $27.05.
newsitem.headline: Grace Q3 EPS from discontinued opns $27.05.

text.p: W. R. Grace & Co said its third quarter earnings of $2.52 billion, or $27.66 a share, included income from discontinued operations of $2.46 billion, or $27.05 a share,
Third quarter earnings from continuing operations were $0.61 a share, compared to $0.20 a year earlier, it said.

Grace said income from discontinued operations included an estimated gain resulting from the September spin-off of the packaging and specialty chemicals businesses, and the combination of Grace's National Medical Care subsidiary with the worldwide dialysis business of Fresenius AG to form a new company called Fresenius Medical Care AG.

"We continue to be optimistic about the future of the new Grace and the progress we are making toward our goal of becoming a top quartile performer among packaging and specialty chemicals companies," said Grace Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer Albert Costello.

"We are encouraged by our margin improvement of three percentage points compared to the year-ago quarter, as well as our continuing sales levels -- especially in the face of adverse market conditions and in comparison to the exceptionally strong growth we experienced in 1995," he said.
Grace reported third quarter sales of $821 million, compared to $946 million a year earlier.
